description: 201 body of POST /items (operationId createItem). The new item (no photo link yet, no finder ID) and the presigned POST form for the photo upload. The upload form is a credential for exactly one object, photos/{itemId}.jpg, image/jpeg, 1 to 10485760 bytes, for 5 minutes: never log it or send the Authorization header to S3. The web app sends upload.fields as plain form fields, then the photo last in a field named file.

UploadForm.description: A presigned POST for the photo. Only works for this item's photo, and only until expiresAt (5 minutes after the answer).

url.description: Where to send the form: the photos bucket in us-east-2. HTTPS only.

fields.description: Form fields to send exactly as given, before the file. S3 sets the names and they can change, so loop over the object and do not hard-code them. Today: key, Content-Type, policy, x-amz-algorithm, x-amz-credential, x-amz-date, x-amz-security-token, x-amz-signature. This is a string-to-string map, so additionalProperties is a string schema here, not false.
